documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call transcript, highlighting resilience despite a challenging operating environment marked by global supply-side disruptions, raw material inflation, and geopolitical uncertainties. Quarterly revenue from operations reached ₹532 crore with EBITDA at ₹89 crore, supported by disciplined cost management, diversified sourcing, and newly introduced complex fertilizer variants. Management noted that raw material constraints initially impacted production, but conditions have since improved, leading to a positive demand outlook for the remainder of FY27 driven by monsoon recovery and higher MSPs. For Q1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem reported revenue growth of 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore and Profit After Tax growth of 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore. Expanded capacities at Meghnagar, including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA, are now contributing progressively to performance.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during FY27.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects expanded capacity to generate a top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.
guidance.quote: So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management projects overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The benefits of capacity expansion are expected to meaningfully reflect in company performance from FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

demand_outlook.claim: NPK-DAP facility utilization is expected to be higher in Q2 compared to Q1 as raw material problems have been resolved.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, definitely it will be higher than Quarter 1.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government support are expected to support fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth due to strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and government support via NBS create a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Kharif season demand appears constructive due to comfortable domestic inventory levels and a favorable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry P&K production reached 15.76 lakh metric tonnes during the peak period of the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: This was reflected in strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak period, marking one of the highest monthly output levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable, supported by reservoir levels and near-normal monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as approximately 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported.
demand_outlook.quote: Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or disclosed through statutory channels.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities. Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA are progressively contributing to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed expansion of its NPK/DAP capacity to 495,000 MTPA, bringing total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid backward integration capacity was expanded to 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that no additional capex beyond completed projects is currently planned.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

capex_expansion.claim: The company executed a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on roughly 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore due to sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution across our integrated value chain.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 90 crore, up 59% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA rose 62% YoY to Rs. 298 crore.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to Rs.298 crore, up 62% YoY, supported by improved operating performance, and a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton on manufactured products was around Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in trading business ranges between 5% and 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

margins_costs.claim: Sulfur prices have been fluctuating in the range of Rs. 55,000 to Rs. 70,000 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: The prices are changing and prices are in the range of around Rs.55,000 to Rs.70,000 per ton, depending on the supplier and what time we are buying and what are the payment terms.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the quarter stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, with an added 165,000 MT taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed manufacturing capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production in Q4 FY26 reached 94,103 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production in FY26 stood at 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, manufacturing volumes were 383,000 MT while trading volumes were approximately 93,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Management expects to import around 150,000 MT of material in FY27, generating around Rs. 1,000 crore revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split to subdivide the face value of equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Management's strategic blueprint includes disciplined capital allocation alongside backward integration and capacity expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: The recent capacity expansion was funded through internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables were around Rs. 400 crore and other receivables were between Rs. 300 crore and Rs. 325 crore at the end of FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's effective interest cost for borrowings ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane uncertainties introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices rose from around ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input costs for fertilizer intermediates increased from mid-February due to supply constraints, gas tightness, and higher freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Indian fertilizer industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: Green ammonia capacity from a third-party agreement with SECI will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Green ammonia supply under the long-term contract is expected after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
